name: Aidron
traits: Defiant toward chromatic dragons. May ally if freed.
flaws: Imprisoned and weakened — Sparkrender plans to sacrifice him.
summary: Bronze wyrmling prisoner — key to Sparkrender's ritual. Left Runara's tutelage ~5 days before party arrival.
backstory: Met Sparkrender at the observatory and refused to join him. Was overpowered and imprisoned. Sparkrender believes Aidron must be sacrificed to bind dead dragon spirits.
notes: Freeing Aidron may turn the finale. Hatred of chromatic dragons stronger than disagreement with Runara.
